e3:SearchQuery.query: SELECT VGGS.KEY_GB_SOCIETY as SearchKey, VGGS.GBS_NAME as SearchName FROM V_GSK_GB_SOCIETY vggs WHERE VGGS.KEY_TYPE_SOCIETY = 58602order by VGGS.KEY_GB_SOCIETY
SELECT VGS.KEY as SearchKey, VGS.GBS_NAME as SearchName FROM V_GB_SOCIETY vgs WHERE VGS.KEY_TYPE_SOCIETY IN (58602, 58604)ORDER BY VGS.KEY

SELECT VGSO.KEY_OFFICIAL as SearchKey, VGSO.LAST_NAME, VGSO.FIRST_NAME, VGSO.SECOND_NAME, VGSO.APPOINTMENT, VGSO.KEY_ADDRESS, VGSO.PHONE, VGSO.EMAIL, VGSO.DATE_BEGIN, VGSO.DATE_END, VGSO.DESCRIPTION FROM V_GSK_S_OFFICIAL vgso WHERE (UPPER(TRIM(VGSO.LAST_NAME)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(:LAST_NAME)) || '%' OR :LAST_NAME IS NULL) AND (UPPER(TRIM(VGSO.FIRST_NAME)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(:FIRST_NAME)) || '%' OR :FIRST_NAME IS NULL) AND (UPPER(TRIM(VGSO.SECOND_NAME)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(:SECOND_NAME)) || '%' OR :SECOND_NAME IS NULL) AND (TRIM(VGSO.APPOINTMENT) LIKE '%' || TRIM(:APPOINTMENT) || '%' OR :APPOINTMENT IS NULL) AND (UPPER(TRIM(VGSO.PHONE)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(:PHONE)) || '%' OR :PHONE IS NULL) AND (UPPER(TRIM(VGSO.EMAIL)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(:EMAIL)) || '%' OR :EMAIL IS NULL) AND ((TRUNC(VGSO.DATE_BEGIN) >= :DATE_BEGIN_OT OR :DATE_BEGIN_OT IS NULL) AND (TRUNC(VGSO.DATE_BEGIN) <= :DATE_BEGIN_DO OR :DATE_BEGIN_DO IS NULL)) AND ((TRUNC(VGSO.DATE_END) >= :DATE_END_OT OR :DATE_END_OT IS NULL) AND (TRUNC(VGSO.DATE_END) <= :DATE_END_DO OR :DATE_END_DO IS NULL))order by VGSO.LAST_NAME

SELECT VGGS.KEY_GB_SOCIETY as SearchKey, VGGS.KEY_TYPE_SOCIETY, (select V.PROPERTY_NAME from V_S_TYPE_SOCIETY v where V.KEY = VGGS.KEY_TYPE_SOCIETY) as TYPE_SOCIETY, VGGS.GBS_NAME, VGGS.GBS_LABEL, VGGS.GBS_ADDRESS, VGGS.KEY_DISTRICT, (select V.CITY_DISTRICT_NAME from V_S_CITY_DISTRICT v where V.KEY = VGGS.KEY_DISTRICT) as DISTRICT, VGGS.KEY_OFFICIAL, (select V.FIO from V_GSK_S_OFFICIAL v where V.KEY_OFFICIAL = VGGS.KEY_OFFICIAL) as OFFICIAL, (select V.PHONE from V_GSK_S_OFFICIAL v where V.KEY_OFFICIAL = VGGS.KEY_OFFICIAL) as PHONE, VGGS.INN, VGGS.CADASTRAL_NUMBER, VGGS.KEY_EXIST_CONTRACT, (select V.PROPERTY_NAME from V_S_YES_NO v where V.KEY = VGGS.KEY_EXIST_CONTRACT) as EXIST_CONTRACT, VGGS.KEY_CAUSE, (select V.PROPERTY_NAME from V_GSK_S_CAUSE v where V.KEY_CAUSE = VGGS.KEY_CAUSE) as CAUSE, VGGS.DATE_BEGIN, VGGS.DATE_END, VGGS.DESCRIPTION FROM V_GSK_GB_SOCIETY vggs WHERE (VGGS.KEY_TYPE_SOCIETY = :KEY_TYPE_SOCIETY OR :KEY_TYPE_SOCIETY IS NULL) AND (UPPER(TRIM(VGGS.GBS_NAME)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(:GBS_NAME)) || '%' OR :GBS_NAME IS NULL) AND (UPPER(TRIM(VGGS.GBS_ADDRESS)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(:GBS_ADDRESS)) || '%' OR :GBS_ADDRESS IS NULL) AND (VGGS.KEY_DISTRICT = :KEY_DISTRICT OR :KEY_DISTRICT IS NULL) AND (VGGS.KEY_OFFICIAL = :KEY_OFFICIAL OR :KEY_OFFICIAL IS NULL) AND (UPPER(VGGS.INN) LIKE '%' || UPPER(:INN) || '%' OR :INN IS NULL) AND (UPPER(VGGS.CADASTRAL_NUMBER) LIKE '%' || UPPER(:CADASTRAL_NUMBER) || '%' OR :CADASTRAL_NUMBER IS NULL) AND ((VGGS.KEY_EXIST_CONTRACT = 14701 and :KEY_EXIST_CONTRACT = 14701) OR (VGGS.KEY_EXIST_CONTRACT = 14702 and :KEY_EXIST_CONTRACT = 14702 or VGGS.KEY_EXIST_CONTRACT IS NULL and :KEY_EXIST_CONTRACT = 14702) OR (VGGS.KEY_EXIST_CONTRACT = 14701 and :KEY_EXIST_CONTRACT IS NULL OR VGGS.KEY_EXIST_CONTRACT = 14702 and :KEY_EXIST_CONTRACT IS NULL OR VGGS.KEY_EXIST_CONTRACT is null and :KEY_EXIST_CONTRACT IS NULL)) AND (VGGS.KEY_CAUSE = :KEY_CAUSE OR :KEY_CAUSE IS NULL) AND ((TRUNC(VGGS.DATE_BEGIN) >= :DATE_BEGIN_OT OR :DATE_BEGIN_OT IS NULL) AND (TRUNC(VGGS.DATE_BEGIN) <= :DATE_BEGIN_DO OR :DATE_BEGIN_DO IS NULL)) AND ((TRUNC(VGGS.DATE_END) >= :DATE_END_OT OR :DATE_END_OT IS NULL) AND (TRUNC(VGGS.DATE_END) <= :DATE_END_DO OR :DATE_END_DO IS NULL))order by VGGS.KEY_GB_SOCIETY

SELECT VGC.KEY_CONFERENCE as SearchKey, VGC.THEME_CONFERENCE, VGC.DATETIME_CONFERENCE, VGC.ADDRESS_CONFERENCE, VGC.CABINET, VGC.KEY_CHAIRMAN, (select V.FIO from V_GSK_S_OFFICIAL v where V.KEY_OFFICIAL = VGC.KEY_CHAIRMAN) as CHAIRMAN, VGC.KEY_SECRETARY, (select V.FIO from V_GSK_S_OFFICIAL v where V.KEY_OFFICIAL = VGC.KEY_SECRETARY) as SECRETARY, VGC.DESCRIPTION FROM V_GSK_CONFERENCE vgc WHERE (UPPER(TRIM(VGC.THEME_CONFERENCE)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(:THEME_CONFERENCE)) || '%' OR :THEME_CONFERENCE IS NULL) AND (UPPER(VGC.DATETIME_CONFERENCE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(:DATETIME_CONFERENCE) || '%' OR :DATETIME_CONFERENCE IS NULL) AND (UPPER(TRIM(VGC.ADDRESS_CONFERENCE)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(:ADDRESS_CONFERENCE)) || '%' OR :ADDRESS_CONFERENCE IS NULL) AND (UPPER(TRIM(VGC.CABINET)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(TRIM(:CABINET)) || '%' OR :CABINET IS NULL) AND (VGC.KEY_CHAIRMAN = :KEY_CHAIRMAN OR :KEY_CHAIRMAN IS NULL) AND (VGC.KEY_SECRETARY = :KEY_SECRETARY OR :KEY_SECRETARY IS NULL)order by VGC.KEY_CONFERENCE
select GSC.KEY_CAUSE as SearchKey ,GSC.PROPERTY_NAME as SearchName from V_GSK_S_CAUSE gscorder by GSC.PROPERTY_NAME
select GSC.KEY_CAUSE as SearchKey ,GSC.PROPERTY_NAME as SearchName from V_GSK_S_CAUSE gsc where GSC.DATE_END is nullorder by GSC.PROPERTY_NAME
select GSO.KEY_OFFICIAL as SearchKey ,GSO.FIO_APPOINTMENT as SearchName from V_GSK_S_OFFICIAL gso where GSO.DATE_END is nullorder by GSO.FIO_APPOINTMENT
select GSO.KEY_OFFICIAL as SearchKey ,GSO.FIO_APPOINTMENT as SearchName from V_GSK_S_OFFICIAL gsoorder by GSO.FIO
select V.KEY as SearchKey ,V.PROPERTY_NAME as SearchName from V_S_YES_NO v
select V.KEY as SearchKey ,V.PROPERTY_NAME as SearchName from V_S_TYPE_SOCIETY v
select V.KEY_SIGN_FORIML as SearchKey ,V.SIGN_NAME as SearchName from V_GSK_S_SIGN_FORIMLIZATION v

SELECT STREET_KEY, STREET_HOUSE, STREET_HOUSE_KEY, HOUSE_NUMBER FROM V_STREET_HOUSE_ALL WHERE (STREET_KEY = :STREET_KEY OR :STREET_KEY IS NULL) AND (HOUSE_NUMBER = :HOUSE_NUMBER OR :HOUSE_NUMBER IS NULL)
SELECT V.STREET_KEY as SearchKey ,V.STREET as SearchName FROM V_STREET v WHERE V.CITY_KEY = 1 AND V.DATE_END IS NULLORDER BY V.STREET
SELECT V.KEY as SearchKey ,V.CITY_DISTRICT_NAME as SearchName FROM V_S_CITY_DISTRICT v WHERE V.DATE_END IS NULLORDER BY V.CITY_DISTRICT_NAME
SELECT V.KEY as SearchKey ,V.CITY_DISTRICT_NAME as SearchName FROM V_S_CITY_DISTRICT vORDER BY V.CITY_DISTRICT_NAME

select V.ADDRESS_KEY as SearchKey ,V.Q_ADDRESS from V_GSK_ADDRESS v where (V.STREET_KEY = :STREET_KEY or :STREET_KEY is null) and (upper(V.HOUSE_NUMBER) like '%' || upper(:HOUSE_NUMBER) || '%' or :HOUSE_NUMBER is null) and (upper(trim(V.DESCRIPTION)) like '%' || upper(trim(:DESCRIPTION_ADR)) || '%' or :DESCRIPTION_ADR is null)order by V.Q_ADDRESS
